rule: every row names a runnable checker or test and a planted mutant; a row without a passing checker cannot be PROVED; no novelty claim

obligations.statement: Canonical meaning form: for typed hypergraph fragments with ≤ 7 nodes, canonical(g1) = canonical(g2) iff g1 ≅ g2 (exhaustive within colour classes); beyond the bound CANNOT_CHECK, never a hash; seed = seed ∘ can so two parsers with different node numbering seed navigation identically.
obligations.limitation: exact only up to the registered bound MAX_EXACT_CANONICAL = 7

obligations.statement: Lexical ambiguity is an ambiguity set: a token's readings are candidates each with its own interval; the token is READINGS iff exactly one LIVE and none UNKNOWN, AMBIGUOUS otherwise; collapse only by revocation/clarification evidence; same-analysis derivations merge as ⊕; unknown tokens are UNKNOWN_LEXEME (no spelling-similarity guess).
obligations.proof: batch-1 T6 (candidate warrant) applied to readings; src/ocm/language/lexicon.py
obligations.parent: candidate/alternative semantics of the antichain semiring (KS-T01)

obligations.statement: Morphological override law: a LIVE EXCEPTION rule for (lemma, category, features) pre-empts every PRODUCTIVE rule for that key whatever token is analysed; revoking the exception's evidence makes the regularised form available and touches no other lemma.
obligations.mutant: (override keyed on the token instead of the lemma — ledger S12, fixed)

obligations.statement: Candidate warrant of a parse: Λ(candidate) = Λ(construction) ⊗ ⨂ Λ(parts), a phrase contributing its own ⊗; isomorphic candidates from different derivations merge as ⊕; the verdict is INTERPRETED iff exactly one LIVE candidate and none UNKNOWN; AMBIGUOUS retains all candidates and a score outside the lattice may only order them.
obligations.limitation: finite fixtures; nogood filter applied after composition (KS-T25)

obligations.statement: Grounding boundary: parsing success yields said(speaker, meaning) as OBSERVATION evidence with Authority.of(speaker=1); world_truth is 0 and stays 0 under any composition of speakers; answers cite evidence and return UNKNOWN when nothing on record supports or denies; contradictory statements are both kept; the only promotion is the authority meet with a bridge.
obligations.proof: ORION-V2 batch-2 B1; src/ocm/language/interpret.py promote_authority; src/ocm/language/session.py
obligations.limitation: the discourse record is in-session state plus ledger evidence; anaphora and context binding beyond explicit bindings are open

obligations.statement: Construction acquisition: over a registered finite pattern class, a demonstration (utterance, meaning) is consistent with h iff parsing under h realises an isomorphic meaning; promotion iff agreement on the query family; warrant = ⊗ of the pinning demonstrations; AMBIGUOUS is not promoted; CONTRADICTION is preserved; an instruction names a hypothesis and is refuted by a contradicting demonstration; constructions are language-scoped.
obligations.limitation: finite classes only; recursive/infinite grammars are OPEN

obligations.statement: Recursive composition: phrase-level constructions (produces=NP) are built bottom-up over spans and bound as single arguments by clause constructions; the merged fragment relabels the phrase head onto the argument node and keeps the phrase's ⊗ warrant.
obligations.mutant: (flat pattern without a modifier slot — ledger S13)
obligations.limitation: no general theorem yet: locality of phrase warrants under revocation is the KS-T22 corollary but is not separately checked

obligations.statement: Freeze-before-outcome for evaluation: the protected split is fixed by content hash before tuning; held-out lexemes never appear in dev; the evaluation receipt is deleted before each run and its exit code checked (stale receipts are CANNOT_CHECK, ledger S14).
obligations.mutant: (stale receipt read as result — ledger S14)

obligations.statement: Real-language evaluation (UD EWT structural, BLiMP acceptability comparator) — custody manifests bound; evaluators and results are M3 follow-ups.
obligations.parent: UD (Nivre et al. 2020); BLiMP (Warstadt et al. 2020)
